content.title: Precious Metals Drop After Trump Posts About Greenland Deal
content.summary: 1503 ET – Gold and silver turned lower after President Trump posted on Truth Social that he had reached “the framework” a deal with NATO Secretary General  Mark Rutte  over Greenland and the Arctic region.  Trump added that previously threatened tariffs will not be imposed as a result, but said that “further information will be made available as discussions progress.”  Gold futures settled trading higher Wednesday, but trading after the settling of these prices turned sharply lower in the wake of Trump’s post.
